info.title: Cloud Slicer API
info.description: This API provides secure, cloud-based 3D printing services, including 3D file upload and management, instant quoting, printability checks, and slicing operations through a modern, REST API interface.

post.description:
Upload a file to the database for the authenticated user.

Requires a valid API token in the Authorization header (Bearer scheme).
You can generate a token from the Cloud Slicer website in your account settings.
The upload must be a .stl, .obj, .3mf, .amf, or .step/.stp file.
Returns details about the uploaded file, including its ID and storage path.

500.description: Internal server error during upload

get.description:
Generate an upload ID for uploading a file to the database.

Requires a valid API token in the Authorization header (Bearer scheme).
Returns an upload id that can be used with the /file/public/{upload_id} endpoint
to upload files without authentication. The upload id expires after 1 hour.

Workflow:
1. Call this endpoint to get an upload_id
2. Use the upload_id with POST /file/public/{upload_id} to upload the file

500.description: Internal server error while generating upload ID

delete.description:
Deletes an uploaded file and its associated gcode from storage. **The quote record is
kept** — its `file_path` and `gcode_path` are cleared (set to null) rather than deleted,
so quote and order history is preserved.

Requires a valid API token in the Authorization header (Bearer scheme).
You can generate a token from the Cloud Slicer website in your account settings.
Accepts the file ID as a query parameter.
Returns a deleted message and the path of the removed file if deletion is successful.

FilamentBreakdown.title: FilamentBreakdown
FilamentBreakdown.description:
**Per-feature filament usage, derived from the sliced G-code.**


Neither PrusaSlicer nor Bambu Studio reports this directly. It is
reconstructed from the sliced file and scaled so the parts sum exactly to
`total_weight_g`, the same whole-print figure the quote is priced on.


`features` always carries the same fixed key set whichever slicer produced
the quote, so you can switch slicers without a key disappearing. Features the
print did not use are present with zero values. The keys are
`external_perimeter`, `perimeter`, `overhang_perimeter`, `solid_infill`,
`top_solid_infill`, `internal_infill`, `bridge_infill`, `gap_fill`,
`ironing`, `skirt_brim`, `support`, `support_interface`, `wipe_tower`,
`custom` and `other`.


    total_weight_g (float): Whole-print filament weight in grams.

    support_weight_g (float): Filament spent on supports and support
        interface, in grams.

    model_weight_g (float): total_weight_g minus support_weight_g. Purge,
        skirt and wipe-tower material is included here; subtract the
        `custom`, `skirt_brim` and `wipe_tower` features to exclude it.

    support_percent (float): Support share of the print, as a percentage.

    features (dict[str, FilamentFeatureUsage]): Usage keyed by feature name,
        from the fixed key set above.


This is reporting only and does not affect pricing.

GeometryInfo.title: GeometryInfo
GeometryInfo.description:
**Build-plate geometry, measured from the sliced first layer:**

    first_layer_area_mm2 (float): Area of the layer that is printed first, in mm².
        This is the geometry that actually contacts the build plate, so when
        supports and a pad are enabled (the default) it is the pad footprint,
        which is larger than the model's own cross-section.

    build_plate_area_mm2 (float): Total usable build-plate area in mm².

    build_plate_coverage_percent (float): Share of the build plate consumed by
        the first layer, as a percentage.

    max_models_per_plate (int): floor(build plate area / first layer area).
        A pure area ratio and therefore an **upper bound** — it ignores part
        shape and any spacing required between parts.


Populated only for technology="sla" quotes; None for FDM.

top_shell_thickness.title: Top Shell Thickness
top_shell_thickness.description: Minimum thickness of the top shell in mm. The number of top solid layers is raised above top_layers if needed to reach it. 0 disables the constraint so top_layers is used as-is.

bottom_shell_thickness.title: Bottom Shell Thickness
bottom_shell_thickness.description: Minimum thickness of the bottom shell in mm. The number of bottom solid layers is raised above bottom_layers if needed to reach it. 0 disables the constraint so bottom_layers is used as-is.

PricingBreakdown.title: PricingBreakdown
PricingBreakdown.description:
**Detailed pricing information:**

    total_price (float): The total price for the print job.

    filament_cost (float): The cost of filament used.

    time (TimeEstimate): Time estimation details.

    pricing (PricingBreakdown): Detailed pricing breakdown.

    filament_breakdown (FilamentBreakdown): Per-feature material usage,
        including how much of the print is support. Reporting only - it does
        not affect any price above. None for SLA quotes, for FDM quotes whose
        G-code could not be walked, and for any FDM quote that has not finished
        slicing yet - it is only written once the quote completes.

    configurations (ConfigurationInfo): Configuration IDs and full config data.
